research_question: RQ1: how does a pretrained encoder trade detection quality against cost, and how sensitive is it to the fine-tuning learning rate?

selection.candidates: every (learning_rate, epoch) pair of the primary seed
selection.note: D1 validation only. D1/D2/D3/D4 test scores are produced once, after the checkpoint is frozen.

seed_stability.protocol: Retrain the frozen learning rate and epoch budget with each seed; the primary seed 6405 stays the reported pipeline. All seeds are reported so the spread is visible; the seed with the best test score is never substituted for the primary model.
seed_stability.handoff_role: supplementary evidence only; the E6 handoff scores come from the primary seed

evaluation.handoff_note: tF1 and t5 are selected by E6 from the raw D1 validation scores, not here.

latency.hardware_note: Single consumer laptop GPU; timings are not comparable to server hardware.

resources.compute_budget: 2 learning rates x 3 epochs = 6 fine-tuning runs, plus 2 extra seeds for the frozen configuration
